goal: Let the server and the app read one account tier policy so Astrology AI follows the closed-test switch (every signed-in account is Premium) with an Owner-set limit of 1 request per local day, instead of requiring a paid subscription row that no tester has.
successCriteria: packages/agent-config/account-tier-policy.json holds mode, trialHours, premiumOnSale and the Astrology AI daily limit and day offset; apps/mobile accountTierPolicy.ts reads it, with unchanged behaviour and tests.

supabase/functions/_shared/account-tier-policy.ts resolves the policy tier for an authenticated user (all_premium: premium; new_account_trial: premium within trialHours of auth created_at; free: free) and the start of the local day from the configured offset.

ai-astrology-insight accepts a request when the user has an active premium_astrology_ai subscription OR the policy tier is premium, and limits attempts to the policy daily limit counted from local midnight (UTC+7 by default), returning the existing 403/429 codes otherwise.
Deno tests cover the policy modes, the trial boundary and the local-day start; the mobile suite still passes.
Nothing is deployed: the Edge Function deploy needs a separate Owner approval.
untouchedSurfaces: No migration, SQL, secrets or Supabase settings change.
Other AI endpoints keep their current checks.

impact.entryPoint: Astrology chart > Đọc sâu với AI / Hỏi Nilaza về lá số.
impact.dataWrite: No new tables; the existing usage_events row astrology_ai_insight_attempted is still written per attempt.
impact.backendContract: Same request and response; 403 premium_required and 429 daily_limit_reached keep their meaning with the new rule.
impact.canonicalContract: account-tier-policy.json becomes the single switch for client display and Astrology AI server access.
impact.privacySafety: No new data; access widens only to signed-in accounts during closed test, capped at 1 per day.
impact.rollback: Set mode to free or revert; redeploy needed for the server part.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Backend, spreads data, share and journal formats.
impact.agentHandoff: The delivery agent owns only the writeScope, runs the validation commands, commits locally and does not merge, deploy or run SQL.

canonicalContracts: Owner decision 2026-10-31: server reads the shared account tier switch (closed test = every signed-in account) with 1 Astrology AI request per day; deploy approved separately.
Owner decision 2026-10-30: one account tier switch (all_premium for closed test).

managerTestPath: After an approved deploy: as a closed-test account, open your chart and ask Nilaza; the first question today is answered, the second says the daily limit is reached.
residualRisk: Until the Edge Function is redeployed the server still requires a subscription row, so the app keeps the AI block hidden.
